title: Deposition of Romulus Augustulus
summary: Odoacer deposes the last western emperor, a conventional date for the “fall of Rome.”
body: The eastern empire continued from Constantinople. In the west, barbarian kingdoms ruled a still-Roman landscape. 476 is a bookmark, not an extinction. Editorial draft for this timeline, not a substitute for specialist literature.

sources.name: Heather, The Fall of the Roman Empire
